name: condux
description: Codex skills for lean agentic workflow: tier routing, discovery, plan drafting, tests-first, subagent coordination, finalize, code review, preflight, root-cause debugging, interactive plan review, and feature spec management.

interface.longDescription: Condux gives Codex a tiered workflow system — Small, Medium, or Large — with lean task cards, opt-in tests-first, on-request code review, and a single end-of-task quality gate. No runaway reviews, no mid-task tests, no monstrous plans.
